Subject: Cascade plan for privileged roles — review & sign-off

Team —

Attached is a focused cascade plan for the small subset of privileged roles that need a quiet review and staged communication during the annual performance cycle. Key context: these roles are in scope for additional privacy controls and need manager sign-off before we notify ICs.

What I need from you this week:
- Quick read and redlines on the attached workbook (privileged_roles_cascade_plan_v2.xlsx) — highlight any role mismatches or omitted owners.
- Signoff on the manager checklist (manager_signoff_checklist.pdf) or edits back to me by EOD Tue 7/20.
- Confirm whether we should route escalation notices to Legal or to the Security Ops team (suggested: Security Ops).

Tentative schedule:
- 7/20: manager signoff window closes
- 7/22–7/24: condensed manager syncs (15min) to confirm messaging and handoffs
- 7/28: quiet rollout to affected managers (no general comms)

Attachments: privileged_roles_cascade_plan_v2.xlsx, manager_signoff_checklist.pdf

If you have edits, add them directly to the sheet and leave a short comment — I will consolidate. If you prefer, flag in a reply and I’ll make the change.

Thanks — short and sharp here, we don’t want this to leak or create undue worry.

—
David Kim
Director, People & Org Operations
Redwood Inference
